pins.definition: Land outside towns and cities, with nature and farms.
Areas outside of towns and cities, with fields, forests, and farms.
Rural areas outside of cities, as a place to live or spend time.

situation: A farmer pauses on a dirt path between wide green wheat fields, far away from any town.
subject: open fields and nature outside towns
brief: An old red tractor stands idle beside a wide-open expanse of rolling green pastures and patchwork fields under a vast, cloudless blue sky, with no buildings or city smoke in sight to the very edge of the horizon.
prompt: An old red tractor stands idle beside a wide-open expanse of rolling green pastures and patchwork fields under a vast, cloudless blue sky, with no buildings or city smoke in sight to the very edge of the horizon. a naïve folk painting, flattened perspective, decorative repeating pattern in the borders and fabrics, warm earthy palette, everything lovingly overfilled. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
